page.layout: One page of running text in one column; marginal notes in the left margin beside the second paragraph. No headings. Printed page number at the head, running head at the top, catchword at the bottom right.
page.running_head: De Agro Frif. inter Lavic. & Amaf.

main_text.p: psius[?] mandato jus dicerent. Nec quicquam CAROLUS CAESAR, aut filius ejus PHILIPPUS mutarunt, eoque modo res ad hæc postrema tempora pervenit. Tum lis de toto fœdere, totaque hac cum civitate conjunctione mota. Eam refuscitatam nuper ORDINES GENERALES eo, quo expofui, modo definierunt.

Præfectu-ra, & præfecti extraurbe.Sed aliud quoque imperium in agro civitas habet haud spernendum. Id duas amplectitur Præfecturas majores, eamquam VETEREM nominant, & SUBURBANAM : quarum illa vicos egregios XVII, hæc XII tantum, nec prioribus pares habet : & in his cœnobia quoque v. Utrique[?] à senatu præfectus datur, mutaturque pro arbitrio. Præfectus prioris ferè consularis, ac genere nobili natus, alterius etiam haud temere alius, quàm senatorius. Atque ille quidem cum judice, ex indigenis plerumque ei additio, jus dicit, cæteraque imperii peragit senatus nomine, sed non aliter, quàm secundùm leges & morem patrium, à quo recedere non licet. Ex hoc more Præfectura

page.notes: Margin note "Præfectu-ra, & præfecti extraurbe." is split over three lines in the printing; joined here. Doubtful: first word "psius" (the line starts at the page edge, probably "ipsius", read as "psius[?]"); "v. Utrique" (the word before "Utrique" is a dark blotch, so "Utrique" is marked [?]). Running head and printed spelling "Frif." and "Lavic." kept as printed. The faint "Congle" mark at bottom right is a digitiser's watermark and is omitted.
